contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Radiate indeterminate, probably issue of 260-275, Reece period 13. pierced with hole at 9 O'clock obverse. Obverse description: Radiate bust possibly draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--]AVG. Reverse description: Figure standing left with right arm extended and left holding upright sceptre. Diameter: 23.7mm, Weight: 1.78gms, die axis: probably 12
